thesis: Savannah Lions established white’s enduring aggressive benchmark: two power for one mana, with no text needed beyond the pressure created by attacking on turn two.

competitiveTimeline.significance: From early White Weenie and tournament aggro to later nostalgia formats, Savannah Lions became the reference point against which generations of white one-drops were judged.

playbook.role: The Lions belongs in decks that convert early damage into a short game. Curve it into additional threats, removal, or an anthem rather than protecting it as though it were a late-game asset.
